title: nano-agent: A Tiny Model Beats Its Teacher — Verified-Loop Repair with a Sub-1B Language Model
description: A 0.5B-parameter code model placed inside a deterministic verify-propose-apply-reverify loop, with the Rust compiler (cargo check) as the oracle, repairs compiler errors at rates exceeding the mid-tier model that generated its training data. Untrained-in-loop 0% -> SFT 86.7% in-distribution; a failure-driven curriculum lifts frozen out-of-distribution accuracy 44% -> 60% (crossing the 56% teacher bar) -> 72% with a stronger teacher. Includes the controller, SEARCH/REPLACE patch engine, Rust verifier, data generators, frozen eval sets, per-case result JSON, and the accompanying paper. Apache-2.0.
